issue.title: [DocDB][TSan] Rare race in Tablet between calling and overwriting mem_table_flush_filter_factory_

repository.name: yugabyte-db
repository.description: YugabyteDB - the cloud native distributed SQL database for mission-critical applications.

issue.body:
Jira Link: [DB-2967](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-2967)
### Description

When trying to verify my workaround for TSAN [issues](https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db/issues/13323) in cassandra-cpp-driver I ran into this race in `Tablet`. Thread sanitizer output at [0]. There's a race between calling and overwriting the `Tablet::mem_table_flush_filter_factory_` field. Command line producing this failure:

```
ybd tsan -n 10 --cxx-test yb-admin-snapshot-schedule-test --gtest_filter '*ClusterRestartDuringRestore*'
```

The race is rare - it was only detected once in 10 runs. The tests do stop and restart the YugabyteDB cluster, but the race occurs well after the cluster is restarted so it may not be related.
